NavigationService.phobosnav_help_status_:
phobosnav help | status | settings | fly | stop | spawn
Ordinary saves supported. Spawn is an explicit debug grant; normal acquisition uses merchants or assembly. Stop clears thrust; it does not brake. Config changes apply on the next launch; cruise/arrival settings are captured per flight.
